<thought>Since the specific template could not be found using functional group criteria, I will perform a broader search using only the target flavanone SMILES to retrieve any applicable retrosynthetic templates. Once a template ID is obtained, I can apply it to the target molecule to get the precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(C2=CC=CC=C2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
